lines.text: Snowball size when thrown: 100% → 20%, growing to full as it flies
Snowball speed when thrown: 100% → 40%, speeding up as it flies
Bonus damage: full → 50% to 100%, more the farther it flies
Stun: none → 0.25 to 1 second, longer the farther it flies
Knockback: none → 50 to 120 units, more the farther it flies

Gain the Surge Field summoner spell. Casting it creates a zone for 10 seconds: while in it, you gain 40% Movement Speed and 150 Ability Haste for basic abilities, and fire missiles at enemies that deal 30% of the damage you deal. Recast it to teleport back to the zone.
